payload.text: The kovacs baseline rerun with python3-venv. Condition: dc's own read shows python3-venv installed on kovacs (by ssh, a read, no window): apt-cache policy python3-venv names an Installed version, and python3 -c 'import ensurepip' succeeds. A relay alone does not release it: vc relayed hv's word at 07:23Z on 19 Oct that it was in, and dc's reads at 07:35:54Z and 07:36:28Z (kovacs's date -u) found Installed (none) for python3-venv (candidate 3.14.3-0ubuntu2) and python3.14-venv (candidate 3.14.4-1ubuntu0.2), no /usr/lib/python3.14/ensurepip, and no apt run since 17 Oct in /var/log/apt/history.log. The install is kovacs's system work, hv's or kovacs-sysadm's, never dc's. Then: at main's head, prep.sh <label> --sha HEAD and kv-prep.sh <label>, a START to gtools-vc as a kovacs leg (it loads this Mac through kovacs's two vCPUs), kv-window.sh <label> --cargo lua-build shellcheck prez-build lua-plan relink loop. kv-remote.sh now logs whether import ensurepip works and keeps pip's cache in the run's dir (PIP_CACHE_DIR), so ensure_venv's pip install writes nothing in kovacs's home. pdf2md's not ok 5 to 15 and xtrct's 6 and 7 should go, and every remaining failure is named in watch-out 4. Then todo 5 at the last landing's head before hv's push. kovacs's two checked download dirs stay in its /tmp until a restart clears them, both read present at 07:35Z: /tmp/dc-2141-sc090.i5YjL5 and /tmp/dc-2141-lua.61GdRV (refetch with tmp/dc-2141/sc090/kovacs-fetch.sh and kovacs-lua-fetch.sh, then fix the two paths in kv-remote.sh).
